# Path prefixes exempt from tools/hooks/pii_scan.py.
#
# Every synthetic PII-shaped literal in hand-written code carries an inline
# `pii-allow` marker instead, so the exemption is visible at the exact line it
# applies to. Only MACHINE-GENERATED files belong here, and only with a reason.

# npm integrity hashes are base64; some segments coincidentally match the PAN
# pattern (5 uppercase, 4 digits, 1 uppercase). The file is regenerated by every
# `npm install`, so inline markers cannot survive in it, and a dependency
# lockfile cannot contain patient data.
